capabilities: Rewrite the current line or selection with an AI model
Proofread or translate using built-in and custom prompt modes
Show suggestions as a ghost preview accepted with Tab
Connect to any OpenAI-compatible server such as Ollama or OpenAI
Wrap note titles and aliases in wiki links after a rewrite
disambiguation: Not a general AI chat assistant or autocomplete; it only rewrites the current line or selection on demand.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README warns that pointing the Base URL at a remote service sends note content off the machine, with the API key sent as a Bearer token.
motivation: The author tuned it for small local models because correcting one line is easy work for a model like gemma3 and on-demand triggering keeps the machine cool.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in on-demand AI rewriting, and most AI tools target whole documents or next-word autocomplete rather than single lines with small local models.
